detail: Proposed: GitHub scopes for profile-only orgs; stricter gh_config_dir checks; refuse calls a space's profile cannot read; a quota cap for isolated accounts. Known gaps: profile-only orgs cannot be PR-watched yet, and the repo picker and PR-outcome tracker still use the default login.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: all four planned in SP-074; see D-54.
